sentence_stem: Although I was very tired after the long flight,
correct_completion: I went to the meeting on time.
full_sentence: Although I was very tired after the long flight, I went to the meeting on time.
acceptable_variants: I still arrived at the meeting on time.
I went to the meeting anyway.

options.text: so I stayed in bed all day.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' shows contrast, not cause. 'So' introduces a result, which does not fit after 'although'.

options.text: I was tired, so I slept early.
options.why_wrong: This gives a cause and an effect, but 'although' needs a clause that contrasts with the tiredness.

options.text: I went to the meeting on time.

options.why_wrong: This repeats the reason for the tiredness instead of giving a contrasting action.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners whose first language has no separate word for this contrast often choose a result clause with 'so' instead.
translation: Embora eu estivesse muito cansado depois do longo voo, fui à reunião na hora certa.
